6101.Name: HumanBall
6101.NoteUP: Beneath the plush fur of Tufty Ears, there's a forehead of extreme hardness, which explains how they can head-butt enemies without hurting themselves.
6101.NoteDown: After observing Tufty Ears in combat multiple times, I've discovered that their cries can alleviate the pain of allies—a truly magical ability.

6102.Name: ElfBall
6102.NoteUP: During battles, Grassy Orbs focus on boosting the Attack Rating of backline allies.
6102.NoteDown: Grassy Orbs let out a loud cry at the start of battle, reducing damage and negative effects on their Wilder allies.

6103.Name: OrcBall
6103.NoteUP: Don't let their size fool you. Their headbutt could easily break your bones...
6103.NoteDown: Observations show that Dinocera Orbs call their allies with a roar to chase down fleeing prey together.

6104.Name: UndeadBall
6104.NoteUP: Don't try to bully Spirit Orbs just because they're small. Their cry can scare anyone into fleeing!
6104.NoteDown: It seems Spirit Orbs only enjoy playing with Graveborns. Maybe staying away from the living makes them feel safe.

6105.Name: HumanOwl
6105.NoteUP: Flutterplume Owls use magic to slow down their prey, making them as sluggish as snails.
6105.NoteDown: Their soaring grace inspires action, and those prone to procrastination might seek their aid.

6106.Name: ElfDeer
6106.NoteUP: If you wish to receive the blessing of a Bellbellow, make sure not to trample the flowers.
6106.NoteDown: Although gentle and peaceful, Bellbellows don't take kindly to those they sense harboring malice!

6107.Name: OrcSwordL
6107.NoteUP: The claws of Blade Ridges are so sharp that even the thickest armor seems futile against them.
6107.NoteDown: Their resounding roar seems to carry a magical power that invigorates all who hear it.

6108.Name: UndeadPLion
6108.NoteUP: Never underestimate the tiny flame orbs summoned by Feline Vesperios. They can drain your energy without you knowing it.
6108.NoteDown: When the shield provided by a Feline Vesperio for its Graveborn allies wears off, the beast damages and silences nearby enemies.

6109.Name: GDJellyfish
6109.NoteUP: When an Ice Crown revels in its dance, it releases a chill so intense that it condenses the air's moisture into falling icicles.
6109.NoteDown: Upon discovering its ability to freeze objects with its chill, the clever Ice Crown started aiding us in subduing enemies.

6110.Name: HumanFox
6110.Feature: Petal marks on their brows, and three tails.
6110.NoteUP: Be careful. Sometimes Fox Fatale's irresistible charm can be harmful.
6110.NoteDown: Even those who are hostile to Fox Fatale will eventually bow to its glamor!

6111.Name: ElfIbis
6111.Feature: Crimson face and a slender beak.
6111.NoteUP: The claws of Blade Ridges are so sharp that even the thickest armor seems futile against them.
6111.NoteDown: Their resounding roar seems to carry a magical power that invigorates all who hear it.

6112.Name: OrcEfreet
6112.NoteUP: Fire Breather is a good pal to frontline heroes as it helps warriors charge ahead with the shield and Attack Rating.
6112.NoteDown: In an aggressive formation, Fire Breather's opening skill can significantly boost allied heroes on the enemy side of the battlefield.

6113.Name: UndeadSpider
6113.NoteUP: Will the gas mask protect me from being poisoned by Shroom Spooder's mist in the wild?
6113.NoteDown: Do not ever touch the big mushroom beneath Shroom Spooder, because that's its treasure! I believe you don't want to spend the rest of your life in dreadful illusions...

6201.Name: HyperCutyDragon
6201.Feature: Radiant patterns as dazzling as starlight.
6201.NoteUP: But don't be dazzled by its summoned stars! It'll get angry if you get too close, so you can only blame yourself if a star smashes into your head!
6201.NoteDown: When Celestwing spreads its wings... If you manage to stay awake, a dreamlike dome of stars will appear before your eyes.

6202.Name: Grimhoof
6202.Feature: Dread as persistent as a nightmare
6202.NoteUP: Nightfall Pegasus seems to be able to plunge people into desperation... If hit by it, even a dream would turn dark and gloomy.
6202.NoteDown: It strives to protect its companions, but every wound they sustain weighs heavily on its heart... I hope it can learn how to let go.

6203.Name: CarrotRabbit
6203.Feature: Insane red eyes and terrifying ears
6203.NoteUP: Count Snickerfang leaves carrot pits in the ground. Don't underestimate them! Not only do they explode, but little carrots will also fly out to harass you!
6203.NoteDown: Count Snickerfang excels at preparing terrifying gifts, catching its victims off guard!

6204.Name: LunarAries
6204.Feature: A crescent moon atop its head, its body is shrouded with nebulas.
6204.NoteUP: Don't underestimate these nebulas! Companions shrouded in nebula will feel at ease, but as for enemies... They're in for trouble!
6204.NoteDown: Whoa, what a beautiful crescent moon! But does that hazy moonlight bring blessings... or a curse?

6205.Name: CandleDog
6205.Feature: Drips molten wax as it moves
6205.NoteUP: Bright streaks in the sky aren't necessarily shooting stars. They could be Blazefang's sparks!
6205.NoteDown: If you step in its molten wax, you'd better run fast! Once it hardens, you'll be locked in place!
